DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.help: Code LLM (default): deepseek-chat through the OpenAI client at api.deepseek.com.

SAPY_OPENROUTER_QUANT.help: OpenRouter quantisation pinned with the provider above.

SAPY_PROVIDER_LOG.help: JSONL of every code-LLM call: served provider/model/tokens (or the error).

SAPY_THINKING_LOG.help: JSONL path; when set, the coder's <thinking> text of every fresh generation is appended (query, cache key, text).

SAPY_VLM_SEED.help: Optional sampling seed passed to vLLM.

SAPY_SERVE_HTTP_PORT.help: Ray Serve HTTP port for the perception services.

FORCE3D_IMAGE_ROOT.help: Root of the multi-view images the question-file paths are rebased onto (default: $FORCE3D_DATA_ROOT/multiview).

FORCE3D_IMAGE_EXT.help: Image extension after rebasing (default: .jpg, the image pack's format).

SATURN_LOG_LEVEL.help: Log level for the saturn.* loggers (stderr); progress lines on stdout are unaffected.

SATURN_TOOLS_DIR.help: Directory holding vendored third-party checkouts (Orient-Anything-V2, sam3). Default: <repo root>/tools.

SAPY_SAM3_TARGET_INFLIGHT.help: SAM3 autoscaler target in-flight requests per replica.

SAPY_SAM3_MAX_ONGOING.help: SAM3 max concurrent requests per replica.

SAPY_ORIANY_MIN_REPLICAS.help: Orient-Anything autoscaling floor (it is the highest-call-rate service).

SAPY_ORIANY_TARGET_INFLIGHT.help: Orient-Anything autoscaler target in-flight requests per replica.

SAPY_ORIANY_BATCH_SIZE.help: Requests coalesced into one Orient-Anything batch.

SAPY_ORIANY_BATCH_WAIT_S.help: How long a batch waits to fill.

SAPY_ORIANY_INTERNAL_CHUNK.help: Crops per forward pass inside the estimator.

SAPY_CODEGEN_SEED.help: Seed sent to the code LLM (default 0: deterministic decoding where the provider honours it; set another integer to measure program variation).

SAPY_STRICT_ASSIGN.help: 1: assign() raises DegenerateBindingError on an all-zero entity formula (debugging). 0: log and keep the argmax.

SAPY_TRACE_SCORES.help: 1 = record the per-op score trace during execution (O(n^k) serialisation).

SAPY_DUMP_SCORES.help: Set = store unary score vectors per sample (implies the trace).

SAPY_SCORE_STUB.help: Set to a float: exec score() returns this constant (camera slots / self-pairs 0) instead of calling the VLM. For scorer A/B replays of cached programs.

SAPY_SCENE_DUMPS.help: 1 = write per-sample scene JSON dumps even without --generate_reports.
